subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Which durable subagent completion delivery policy should own this umbrella before more automated fixes are queued?
rationale: The bug is real, but the permanent fix changes at-least-once delivery, visible failure semantics, timeout/restart behavior, and duplicate prevention across agent and channel surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and define a durable outbox or equivalent state machine before landing partial retry changes.

options.title: Narrow to linked retry PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 as the near-term fix only after it is rebased, proven live, and repaired.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Move each remaining delivery, timeout, restart, and verification failure mode to a narrower canonical issue before closing or demoting this umbrella.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and define a durable outbox or equivalent state machine before landing partial retry changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history for the central agent lifecycle and docs behavior point to this owner as the best routing candidate.
